claim: TikTok Indonesia's Director of Communications, Anggini Setiawan, explicitly separated the '8 million creators' figure from the '63% above minimum wage' figure into two distinct sources on 10 July 2024: the 8 million count is TikTok's own internal data as of December 2023, while the 63% figure is explicitly attributed to the June 2023 'The TikTok Effect' Kadence-fielded survey report.
stance_target: the '8 million creators, 63% above minimum wage' figure is a single unified statistic from one study
scope_conditions: Kompas.id, AI-translated English version of a 10 July 2024 Indonesian-language article; primary quote from TikTok Indonesia's own communications director at a press event (Creator House launch), not an independent audit
quoted_support: Director of Communications Tiktok Indonesia Anggini Setiawan said, based on internal data as of December 2023, there were more than 8 million creators from Indonesia who received income from Tiktok. Then, according to the research report "The TikTok Effect: Accelerating Southeast Asia's Businesses, Education and Community Report" which Tiktok released in June 2023, as many as 63 percent of Indonesian creators on Tiktok earn income above the minimum wage.
time_period: TikTok internal count as of December 2023; survey report published June 2023; disclosed at press event 10 July 2024

claim: The '8 million creators receiving income from TikTok' figure, as of this article, has no disclosed methodology whatsoever -- no survey, no census, no definition of 'received income' or 'creator' -- and remains, even after the full primary report was recovered, a purely unaudited platform self-disclosure distinct from and unrelated to the Kadence survey.
stance_target: the 8-million-creators figure specifically (as opposed to the 63% figure) remains an untraceable, unauditable statistic
scope_conditions: Audited absence: the full 'The TikTok Effect' report (vault note the-tiktok-effect) was independently recovered and confirmed to contain no population/creator-count figures of any kind, ruling out that report as the source of '8 million'; TikTok has never disclosed the methodology behind this internal figure in any source found across this research run
quoted_support: Director of Communications Tiktok Indonesia Anggini Setiawan said, based on internal data as of December 2023, there were more than 8 million creators from Indonesia who received income from Tiktok.

claim: This same article separately discloses that Indonesian TikTok Shop and Tokopedia together had more than 21 million sellers and TikTok had 125 million monthly Indonesian users, and that 60% of promotional content on TikTok in Indonesia supports local products -- figures also repeated a year later at the July 2025 DPR hearing, indicating some consistency in TikTok Indonesia's talking points over time.
stance_target: consistency of TikTok Indonesia's disclosed platform statistics over a one-year span (July 2024 to July 2025)
scope_conditions: Both disclosures are corporate public-relations statements at company-organized events, not independently audited
quoted_support: Currently, according to Anggini, every month, Tiktok application is visited by 125 million people in Indonesia. Meanwhile, the number of sellers, including MSMEs on Tokopedia and Shop | Tokopedia has reached more than 21 million.
